repos_data.description: A multipurpose ZSH Theme with very detailed git and mercurial prompt.
A simple and elegant multi-line theme for ZSH. Includes a colourized timestamp, `git` & syntax highlighting, and elevated root theme.
A single-file oh-my-zsh theme with Nerd Font icons, exit codes on failure, and middle-collapsed paths
Minimal-OS is a sleek and simple Zsh theme designed for use with Oh-My-Zsh. It provides a minimalist prompt with helpful Git status indicators and system-specific icons.

🙃   A delightful community-driven (with 2,500+ contributors) framework for managing your zsh configuration. Includes 300+ optional plugins (rails, git, macOS, hub, docker, homebrew, node, php, python, etc), 140+ themes to spice up your morning, and an auto-update tool that makes it easy to keep up with the latest updates from the community.
Heavily customizable, compatible, and fast ZSH theme framework.
A cheeky prompt to spice up your terminal 🌶️🐔

This Zsh prompt configuration adds Git status symbols and tracks command execution time. It customizes the prompt with virtual environment details, user info, and the current directory, including Git repository info. The prompt adapts based on the user’s context and provides a clean, informative display.

repo_meta_data.description: A dynamic, humorous, and feature-rich Zsh configuration that combines productivity with playful developer trolling.
